issue.title: Add Recording Warning on Taken Chapters
issue.body: The record tab surfaces two distinct warnings: one when the current chapter is taken by another translator, and one when an unresolved audio take conflict exists on the chapter. Both are informational only; recording is not blocked. This ticket adds both warning banners to the drafting screen. ## Functional Requirements ### Taken Chapter Warning - When the current chapter is claimed or PM-assigned to another translator, display a warning on the record tab (e.g., "This chapter is assigned to another translator."). - Show the warning whether the device is online or offline; the taken state may be server-confirmed (online) or derived from last-synced state (offline). - Allow recording to proceed despite the warning; do not block or disable recording controls. ### Conflict Warning - Display an amber banner at the top of the Record tab content area, above the verse navigator, with `li:triangle-alert` and the text "Unresolved audio take conflict on this chapter/pericope." when the current chapter or pericope has an unresolved audio take conflict. - No resolution action is available on mobile; the banner is informational only. Note: The chapter list conflict indicator is handled in #260.

comments.body:
### Eng note (updated)

Two banners, two realities:

- **Taken by someone else** — use real assignment data we already sync (`assignedUserId` / `peerCheckerId`). No new API.
- **Unresolved audio conflict** — depends on **eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#271**.

**Preferred:** ship the conflict banner with `fluent-api#271` (and #256/#260) as one feature.

**Fallback:** mock only the conflict banner if API is too heavy; keep the taken warning on real data. Don’t block recording either way.

(Not the same as web’s presence “other editor online” warning.)

**Test Results:269**

- For a newly assigned chapter, the assignment warning banner is not displayed initially.
- When the chapter assignment changes and the chapter is assigned to a different translator, the assignment warning message is displayed.
- When the chapter is in Peer Check, the translator receives the expected warning message.
- When the chapter is reassigned to the current translator, the assignment warning message is no longer displayed.
- When the assignment warning is displayed, the user can still record multiple takes, delete existing takes, and record new takes. The warning does not block or disable recording functionality.
- The assignment warning functionality was tested in both online and offline modes and worked as expected.

Moving this ticket to passed QA

**Below these issues Followup tickets created #404**
**Issues Identified**

- When View Source Text is expanded, the chapter/verse navigation is hidden behind the takes section, making it difficult for the user to navigate between verses.
- When very long source text is displayed, it is difficult for the user to scroll through and view the entire text.

**Note**
The Conflict Warning functionality was not tested because the developer has commented on the PR regarding this functionality. Therefore, the conflict-warning requirements remain untested.
